svg.title: Data Mesh Architecture - Rough.js sloppiness 2
svg.desc: Federated governance above domain data products and a self-serve data platform below. An enabling team supports the domains. Solid arrows represent data flow; dashed arrows represent usage. Outlines, hatching, and vector icons rendered with Rough.js at level 2, seed 42.
svg.metadata: {"schemaVersion":"1.0","title":"Data Mesh Architecture","description":"A faithful interpretive recreation of the referenced diagram. Domain membership is explicit; the remote domain is represented as a node to anchor its usage edge. Platform and governance offerings have no implied edges because the source draws none.","nodes":[{"id":"interoperability","label":"Interoperability
